question: Should Microsoft Teams adopt this first-class accounts/defaultAccount contract now, including root-setting inheritance, legacy single-bot compatibility, and account-scoped auth and state?
rationale: The code review can assess correctness, but only maintainers can commit the product to a new durable channel configuration and upgrade contract spanning setup, credentials, routing, and persisted state.

options.title: Sponsor this contract
options.body: Approve the existing multi-account shape and reopen the PR for final Teams and security ownership review before merge.

options.title: Narrow the contract
options.body: Define a smaller supported inheritance or setup surface and ask for a replacement PR implementing only that approved boundary.

options.title: Defer multi-account Teams
options.body: Keep the PR closed until a maintainer is ready to own the configuration, authentication, and state compatibility contract.

recommendation.title: Sponsor this contract
recommendation.body: Approve the existing multi-account shape and reopen the PR for final Teams and security ownership review before merge.
